title: Lemon Drop Salt Nic E-Liquid – Pink 60ml
description:
Description
*This flavour is known to be harsh and a coil killer.
A classic flavor that is truly magical, you haven’t had one quite like this before! Sweet, tangy, sour, perfection!
Lemon Drop Salt is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Lemon Drop Salt E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
Introducing Bold 50!
In response to the new nicotine cap, Lemon Drop is now offering a unique hybrid nicotine blend crafted to provide the throat hit you know and love from the original 50mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, but are only 20mg/ml.
